name: ECE 3231
title: Introduction to Modern Power Systems
description: Fundamentals of power system planning, operation, and management. Power generation, transmission and distribution. Sustainable energy sources such as photovoltaics, solar-thermal power, wind farms, and their grid integration. Modern power system monitoring/control, fault analysis, and transient stability analysis using computer tools. Use of power system simulation tool e.g. PSS/E for power system planning.
requirement_description: ECE 2000 or 2001/W; open only to students in the School of Engineering.
